Vintage Algerian Briar Collection
Leather-Wrapped, 3 Pieces, With Original Case
A vintage collection of smoking pipes from The Longchamp Pipe Company, Paris. Renowned for their signature leather-wrapped designs, Longchamp pipes were traditionally crafted using century-old Algerian briar, selected in the Jura mountains and hand-finished in Paris. This lot represents the classic mid-century French pipe-making tradition, highly regarded by collectors for the unique aesthetic and cooling properties of the leather dressing.
Items Included:
Longchamp Smoking Pipe: Leather-wrapped briar bowl, straight black stem, marked Longchamp France.
Longchamp Smoking Pipe: Cream-colored bowl with black bit, straight billiard-style silhouette.
Longchamp Smoking Pipe: Leather-wrapped briar bowl, dark brown hand-sewn leather, black stem.
Original Presentation Case: Red exterior clamshell case with green velvet-style lining and branded silk interior lid.
Certificate of Authenticity: Original parchment document from The Longchamp Pipe Company certifying materials and origin.
Condition:
The pipes are in used vintage condition. Bowls show significant charring and carbon buildup from previous use. Stems exhibit tooth marks and light oxidation. The leather wrapping shows surface scuffs, discoloration, and age-related wear consistent with handling. The presentation case has visible staining on the interior silk lining and light exterior shelf wear. The included certificate is folded and shows age-toning but remains fully legible. One slot in the case is vacant.

Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production
Embossed "HEMINGRAY - 45" marking prominently on the lower base skirt
Approximately 3.75 inch base diameter and 4 inch total height
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with no major chips or structural cracks. Inner and outer petticoats are intact. Original gloss is well-preserved with minor surface scratches consistent with age and utility service. Threaded core is clean and undamaged.

Kid Galaxy, Vintage 1999-2000
3 Sealed In Tubes, 2 Loose
This collection features five bendable figures from Kid Galaxy's popular Bendos line, which dominated the poseable toy market in the late 1990s and early 2000s. This lot includes three factory-sealed figures in original cylindrical packaging and two loose figures with character-specific accessories.

Mega-Parachute Bendo - Sealed in large tube #604, includes red parachute.

Scuba Diver and Tech Figure - Loose figures with "Kid Galaxy" markings.
Accessories: Diving helmet, daisy acoustic guitar, two money bags, and snowboard.

Enhance your historical collection with this pair of vintage clear glass insulators, classic relics from the era of telegraph and telephone lines. Each insulator displays iconic, rounded contours and subtle amber tinting, showcasing glass craftsmanship from the early-to-mid 20th century. Perfect for collectors or as unique decor, the insulators' robust construction and preserved clarity highlight both their utility and nostalgic charm. Place them on a shelf, use them as paperweights, or incorporate them into upcycled art projects for an industrial twist. These pieces come gently used, with no major chips or cracks visible, and offer a glimpse into utility history with their original patina. Shop confidently knowing these genuine insulators are excellent examples for display, conversation, and educational purposes. Add a distinctive touch to your home or office with this timeless pair a piece of everyday heritage you can hold in your hands.

Striking figural smoking pipe with a finely carved white bowl in the shape of a bearded man wearing a feathered hat, paired with a rich amber-brown curved stem. The carving has excellent detail in the facial features, beard, and hat, giving it a bold display presence whether you smoke it or showcase it in a collection. The pipe comes with a fitted hard case, shaped precisely to the pipe for protection and easy storage. The interior lining cradles the pipe, while the exterior has a classic black finish with brass-tone hardware that adds a vintage look. Perfect for pipe collectors, display in a study or smoking room, or as a distinctive gift for someone who appreciates unique, sculptural pipes. Keywords: figural pipe, carved face pipe, decorative smoking pipe, collectible pipe, curved stem pipe, pipe with case, display pipe
Condition Notes:
Pipe bowl and stem appear clean with no obvious chips or cracks. Carved figural face and hat show sharp detail without visible damage. Stem shows no major bite marks or deep wear at the mouthpiece. Fitted hard case exterior shows surface scuffs, edge wear, small abrasions, and finish wear, while the interior lining appears intact but with light soiling from use. See pictures for reference. Sold as-is.
Aspects:
Color: White bowl with amber-brown stem
Body Shape: Figural face bowl with curved stem

title: Vintage German Hunter Pipe Munchen Modular Wood Tobacco Pipe with Metal Lid
description:
German Hunter Style Tobacco Pipe
Munchen Edition, Modular Construction
Wood, Metal, and Horn, Approximately 6 Inches Long
A classic German "Jager" or hunter-style tobacco pipe, featuring the traditional modular multi-piece construction characteristic of Central European alpine regions. This specific piece is detailed with "Munchen" (Munich) engraved on the bowl, identifying it as a regional piece from the Bavarian capital. Designed for functionality in outdoor settings, these pipes feature long stems to cool the smoke and wind caps to protect the embers.
Modular design consisting of a polished wood bowl, bark-covered wooden stem section, and horn mouthpiece transition
Decorative hinged metal wind cap with ornate perforations and a secure latch mechanism
Accented with a traditional green cord featuring wooden toggle beads and a small decorative tassel
Engraved "Munchen" banner design on the side of the bowl
Condition:
The item is in used condition with visible charring and residue inside the bowl from previous use. The exterior wood finish retains a high gloss with minor surface handling marks. Metal components, including the bands and wind cap, show light tarnish and age-related patina. The modular joints fit securely. The green decorative cord is intact with some minor fraying to the tassel.

All items are new and sealed in their original retail packaging, suitable for everyday lip care.

description:
Title
: Fossil Collection Science Education Kit 12 Identified Specimens Trilobite Shark
Department
: Science & Education
Category
: Collectibles & Art
Condition
: Good - shows some sign of wear
Description
: Explore Earth's ancient past with this 12-piece Fossil Collection Kit, perfect for science enthusiasts and collectors alike. Each fossil is individually bagged and accompanied by an educational card describing its origin and significance, including gastropods, pelycopods, horn coral, crinoid stems, brachiopods, trilobites, dinosaur bone, ammonites, fossil wood, algae, and shark teeth. The set includes a colorful timeline card mapping major periods of prehistoric life, making it a valuable educational tool. Ideal for students, teachers, or hobbyists, these fossils offer hands-on learning about natural history and paleontology. All items shown are included, and each fossil appears in its own clear, labeled packet for easy viewing and storage. The set is presented in good visible condition, with all key contents intact and readable. Delight in the tactile experience of real fossils and enrich your educational collection or science display with this fascinating assortment.
This is a pre-owned item donated to Goodwill of Northern Michigan.
Please see images for further detail and ask any questions you may have before making a bid.
Items have been tested for power, not function. In some instances we may not have the necessary equipment to test certain electronics therefore all items will be auctioned off AS-IS with no refunds.
Items in lots are sold as-is, are not eligible for refunds, and may not be individually wrapped.
Please contact us before making payment to review combined shipping options.
Pick-Ups
We're open Monday - Friday, 8 am - 4 pm. We are closed on weekends and major holidays. For local pickup in Traverse City, please give us 24 hours from time of payment to prepare your order. Thank you!

description:
Petrified Wood and Agate Specimen Lot
Mineral Specimen Lot - 2 Pieces
Polished and Natural, Brown and Tan, Vintage
This mineral collector's lot features two distinct geological specimens showcasing the beauty of silicified minerals. The first is a rectangular block of polished banded stone, possibly jasper or agatized petrified wood, featuring rhythmic wavy bands of sienna, tan, and cream with a translucent agate corner. The second is a natural rough specimen of petrified wood showing dark internal wood-grain patterns and a characteristic stone-hard fossilized texture.
Polished block displays intricate wavy banding and a translucent agate section at one end
Rough specimen exhibits dark carbon-rich fossilized wood grain and bark-like outer texture
Heavy stone-hard composition consistent with silica-replaced fossilized material
Polished block measures approximately 7 inches in length; total lot weight 2 pounds
Condition:
The polished block shows minor surface scratches and a small chip along one edge consistent with vintage display. The rough specimen remains in its natural state with jagged edges and exposed fossilized grain. No significant structural cracks observed. Finish on the block remains glossy despite light wear.

The specimens feature natural rough textures as well as partial tumbling and polishing. Some pieces display unique banding and coloration.

Specifications:
- Mineral Types: Quartz, Agate, Pyrite, Amethyst, Jasper, Obsidian, and others
- Finish: Natural rough, semi-polished, tumbled
- Color Variations: Green, blue, metallic, purple, black, and multicolored
- Lot Weight: Approx. 5 lbs
- Brand Markings: None visible

This lot offers a diverse selection of mineral and gemstone specimens without specific age, origin, or size details.

We generally do not work weekends and therefore shipping is not done on those days.
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html

This requirement is in your best interest and at no cost to you. We are paying for this surcharge and it is our way of giving back to you to ensure you receive your item(s).

. If you place your item on hold for pickup at any Fedex location that has Adult Signature Required, you will be required to show ID but your address on the ID must match the ship to address on the label.
?

If not found, Fedex will pay the claim. When Fedex marks the claim as paid in their system, we will then issue your refund, not before, no exceptions. This process can take 2-4 weeks to resolve. We check on claim statuses Monday - Friday and will issue your refund accordingly.

. You must provide a physical street address. If you have a PO Box setup on your account that you use, you may modify your SHIP TO ADDRESS when submitting your payment.

The items are from the same selling Goodwill.
The items close within the same week.
